name: Bell 505 Jet Ranger X
summary: Five-seat light single-turbine helicopter that pairs JetRanger dynamics with an all-new boxy cabin; used for training, private flying and light utility work.

wings: Two-blade teetering main rotor derived from the JetRanger
engines: Single Safran Arrius turbine behind the cabin under a squared-off cowling
Single exhaust angled up and aft
fuselage: Angular, boxy cabin with very large flat windshield and side windows
Flat floor and big rear doors
tail: Slim tail boom with a horizontal stabilizer carrying endplate fins

tellTales: Boxy, angular cabin with huge flat windows under a two-blade rotor
Squared-off engine cowling with one exhaust on a light single
Two-blade tail rotor with endplate-fin stabilizer

confusedWith.howToTell: The 505 has an angular, slab-sided cabin with very large flat windows; the 206 has a rounded teardrop cabin.
The 407 has four main rotor blades; the 505 has two.
The R66 has a rounded bubble cabin, tall thin mast and tubular boom; the 505 is angular with a short mast and endplate stabilizer.
The Enstrom 480 has a three-blade rotor and a sleek swept canopy; the Bell 505 has a two-blade rotor and a blunt nose.
The EC120 has a three-blade rotor and a ducted tail fan; the Bell 505 has a two-blade rotor and an open tail rotor.
